entities.summary: German invasion (July 1941), the Reichskommissariat Ostland. The Holocaust in Latvia: the Rumbula massacre (November–December 1941) killing over 25,000 Jews, the Riga Ghetto, the Latvian SS Legion, and the massive civilian losses.
